subject: Unforeseen fire protection field condition: sprinkler head spacing conflicting with the

messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the sprinkler head spacing conflicting with the ceiling grid layout at Lobby 101; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Protection Detail 3/FP502. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up work in this area. A response within three business days would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Lobby 101 per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum.
